provenance: Sanitized excerpts from existing real local Devin CLI history, read without starting the agent. The SQLite source was opened with mode=ro. Native DDL is copied from sqlite_master; INSERTs are selected real rows, not invented conversation events.

versionEvidence.note: The installed version directory was observed, and the native transcript explicitly declares agent.version. Neither establishes which version originally wrote the selected older SQLite records.

sanitization: All conversation/system/tool text, commands, reasoning, sealed signatures, descriptions, titles, model identifiers, workspace paths, resource URIs and other private string values are replaced; no ciphertext or binary source data is included.
Session/message/tool/request/event/terminal/skill IDs and dynamic object keys are consistently remapped across selected records; the SQLite node and parent graph is renumbered without changing edges.

Native envelope keys, JSON value types, selected schema enums, tool names, booleans and nulls are preserved. Other numeric payload/metrics are zeroed; timestamp values are replaced by ordered synthetic times. Source row IDs are replaced.
No logs, credentials, trusted_workspace, search index, rendered HTML, prompt history, application state or database binary is copied.

sqlite.selection: Complete main_chain_id ancestry from the smallest source session with persisted tool state; alternative roots and uncommitted sibling nodes are omitted.
relations: tool metadata terminal_id and embedded tool-call object keys

transcript.selection: Native prefix through the first agent step containing tool calls and their observation results, from a different real session. Only the real definitions of tools used by the excerpt are retained.

coverage.usage: Execute sessions.sql in a new temporary SQLite database (for example: sqlite3 /tmp/devin-fixture.db < sessions.sql); read transcript.json directly as the native ATIF-v1.7 envelope. No Devin installation or model access is needed.

limitations: subagent_heads was inspected and empty in the real source, so its actual DDL is included without fabricated rows; no subagent execution is covered.
Only the four history-related native tables and their applicable explicit indexes are included; this is not a complete CLI database backup.
The SQLite source contains duplicate inference/committed sibling nodes and other roots; this minimal fixture retains only the committed main-chain ancestry.
The transcript is a prefix excerpt, not a complete conversation. Its original final_metrics.total_steps remains the full source count, while numeric token metrics are sanitized to zero.
The database and transcript represent different sessions; their IDs intentionally differ. No assertion is made that either session was generated by the currently installed version.
Private payload semantics, actual model identity, real timestamps, reasoning and sealed-data decoding cannot be tested with these fixtures.
